description: Single global tuning row for the virtual/target camera: gaze/rotation/distance attenuation, mode distances and blend times, and horizontal/vertical look limits.

ID.simple: Row name (Only one exported row: Default).
ID.technical: FName serialized on the row, but the accessor does NOT look up by this value: UGameVirtualCamera::FirstCameraRow (retail 0x104a480) takes the first row name of the first CameraDataTables table (+0x310) whose row struct is FGameDataTableRow_Camera and returns that row. No source consumer reads the row's Id member itself; changing the row name alone would not change the selected row as long as it stays first.

GazeLocation_AttenuateRate.technical: Float multiplied by 60 at InitVirtualCamera (0.5 in the export -> 30) and stored in GazeLocationAttenuateRateBase/current. UpdateViewTransform uses DeltaTime * rate as the FMath::Lerp alpha (clamped 0..1) between current and target gaze location. An interpolated override can be driven by the camera's Interp128.

RotationPitch_AttenuateRate.technical: Float * 60 at init (export 0.5 -> 30). Used as DeltaTime * rate in GameVirtualCamera_LerpRotator for current->target pitch; roll uses a hard-coded 30 instead of a row field.

RotationYaw_AttenuateRate.technical: Float * 60 at init (export 0.5 -> 30), used as DeltaTime * rate in the yaw rotator lerp inside UpdateViewTransform.

Distance_AttenuateRate.technical: Float * 60 at init (export 0.5 -> 30). Used as clamped DeltaTime * rate alpha when interpolating CurrentDistance toward TargetDistance.

TargetCamera_Distance.technical: Float (export 200 cm). Copied to CurrentDistance and TargetCameraDistance in InitCharacterCamera and used as the base distance request (key 0) when no movement/down request exists. Gameplay actions request a larger distance and then release it back to this value.

FreeCamera_Distance.technical: Float (export 250 cm) copied to FreeCameraDistance at character-camera init; the free-camera calculation places the camera at Direction * FreeCameraDistance + Base above the owner's height-adjusted base point.

ShootCamera_Distance.technical: Float (export 200 cm) copied to the character virtual camera's ShootCameraDistance member at init and propagated by the camera copy path (GameCharacterVirtualCamera.cpp:718). No further read of that member appears in the available source (the similarly named debug-menu value is a separate GameDebugManager field), so the exact aiming behavior remains unresolved here.

TargetCamera_ActionDistance.technical: Float (export 320 cm). Movement actions call SetDistanceRequest(1, TargetCamera_ActionDistance, <mode-specific time>) so the longest active request wins. Used by normal run, dash, jump, step and CP_180 jump-like actions.

TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_Ru.simple: Blend time for the running camera-distance change.
TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_Ru.technical: Float seconds (export 1.0) passed as BlendTime to SetDistanceRequest(1, ActionDistance, ...) from the run action; UpdateDistanceRequest starts an EaseInOut float interpolation over that time (scaled by remaining alpha when goals repeat).

TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_Da.simple: Blend time for the dash camera-distance change.
TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_Da.technical: Float seconds (export 0.2) passed with TargetCamera_ActionDistance to request key 1 when a dash starts.

TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_Ju.simple: Blend time for the jump camera-distance change.
TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_Ju.technical: Float seconds (export 0.2) used by the normal jump action and CP_180's jump/dash-like actions when requesting TargetCamera_ActionDistance.

TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_St.simple: Blend time for the step camera-distance change.
TargetCamera_ActionDistanceChangeTime_St.technical: Float seconds (export 0.2) passed to the step action's request for TargetCamera_ActionDistance.

TargetCamera_DownDistance.technical: Float (export 475 cm). Blow/down action states call SetDistanceRequest(2, DownDistance, DownDistanceChangeTime); this request competes with the movement request by maximum distance.

TargetCamera_DownDistanceChangeTime.simple: Blend time into the downed camera distance.
TargetCamera_DownDistanceChangeTime.technical: Float seconds (export 0.2) passed together with TargetCamera_DownDistance to SetDistanceRequest(2, ...) from all six down/blow consumer sites.

TargetCamera_NormalDistanceChangeWaitTim.simple: Delay before the camera returns to normal distance.
TargetCamera_NormalDistanceChangeWaitTim.technical: Float seconds (export 3.0). UpdateDistanceRequest(negative blend time) keeps postponing a return while this countdown is active; when requests run out, the first such call sets DistanceRequestWait to this row value and returns without restoring key 0. Blow recovery calls RemoveDistanceRequest(2, NormalDistanceChangeTime).

TargetCamera_NormalDistanceChangeTime.simple: Blend time back to normal camera distance.
TargetCamera_NormalDistanceChangeTime.technical: Float seconds (export 1.5). Used by SetDistanceRequest(0, TargetCameraDistance, NormalDistanceChangeTime) and passed as RemoveDistanceRequest(2, ...) blend when leaving the knocked-down camera state.

LimitAngleH_Min.simple: Horizontal camera limit angle at close range.
LimitAngleH_Min.technical: Float degrees (export 25). Interpolated with LimitAngleH_Max by DistanceAlpha = clamp((Dist2D - LimitAngleHDistanceMin)/(LimitAngleHDistanceMax - LimitAngleHDistanceMin), 0..1); the result rotates the ideal gaze heading about the down axis to compute yaw error/slack.

LimitAngleHDistance_Min.simple: Near distance at which the horizontal limit starts interpolating.
LimitAngleHDistance_Min.technical: Float cm (export 150). Lower bound of the 2D base-to-gaze distance used in the DistanceAlpha clamp for LimitAngleH_Min/Max.

LimitAngleH_Max.simple: Horizontal camera limit angle at long range.
LimitAngleH_Max.technical: Float degrees (export 5). Upper end of the distance-based lerp; a larger-horizon gaze permits less horizontal lag than the 25-degree near value.

LimitAngleHDistance_Max.simple: Far distance at which the horizontal limit reaches its maximum-range value.
LimitAngleHDistance_Max.technical: Float cm (export 700). Upper bound of the DistanceAlpha denominator; the code divides by (Max - Min) without a zero guard.

LimitAngleV_Min.technical: Float degrees (export -40). Pitch is clamped to [-LimitAngleVMax, -LimitAngleVMin] = [-25, 40] with the export values; the sign is inverted because the code passes -Min as the upper clamp.

LimitAngleV_Max.simple: Upper magnitude of the vertical gaze limit.
LimitAngleV_Max.technical: Float degrees (export 25). Supplies the negative bound of the pitch clamp (-25 degrees); see LimitAngleV_Min for the inverted upper bound.

OwnerHeightScale.simple: Fraction of owner capsule height used as camera pivot height.
OwnerHeightScale.technical: Float (export 0.84). InitCharacterCamera computes OwnerHeight = 2 * GetScaledCapsuleHalfHeight() * OwnerHeightScale; the result offsets the camera/gaze base point and participates in lock-on height difference.

TargetCamera_OffsetAngleV.simple: Vertical offset applied to the camera direction.
TargetCamera_OffsetAngleV.technical: Float degrees (export 1.5). OutDirection = Heading.RotateAngleAxis(Pitch - TargetCamera_OffsetAngleV, HeadingAxis); this is subtracted from the clamp-derived pitch when producing the final view direction.

CameraModeChange_InterpolationTime.simple: Blend duration when switching camera modes.
CameraModeChange_InterpolationTime.technical: Float seconds (export 0.25). Stored by InitCharacterCamera and passed to StartViewBlend when the camera mode changes.

notes: Only one row (Default) is exported. The accessor returns the FIRST row of the first table containing a FGameDataTableRow_Camera, so table sharding/localization variants would not be combined; adding rows would not make them selectable by ID without changing retail code.

Manager loading: 'CameraDataTable' -> CameraDataTables (+0x310) at GameDataTableManager.cpp:179/327. CharacterCameraDataTable (+0x460) is a separate per-character table and is not the row documented here.

Attenuation rates are multiplied by 60 at initialization (frame-rate-normalized from the exported per-frame values). Distances are in Unreal centimetres; blending uses EEasingFunc::EaseInOut with exponent 2.
No further consumer for ShootCamera_Distance was found in the available C++/sequencer code; the similarly named debug menu fields belong to GameDebugManager, not to this row.

usages.detail: FirstCameraRow selects the first row of the first CameraDataTable asset; InitVirtualCamera consumes all four attenuation rates (retail 0x1051e30).
InitCharacterCamera copies all distance/limit/height/offset/mode fields from the row into the live camera (retail 0x1291f80).
Camera heading/pitch solver interpolates the horizontal limit by gaze distance and clamps pitch by vertical limits.
SetDistanceRequest/UpdateDistanceRequest arbitrates normal, movement and downed distance requests and applies blend/wait times.
Run, dash, jump, step and CP_180 actions request the action distance with their respective blend times.
Blow/down actions request and later release the downed camera distance using the down distance, change time and normal return time.
